ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the central and lower surface, with high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized to the leading edges and distal tips; approximate ratio of 15% high-intensity to 85% low-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity bands along the distal trailing edges, widening significantly at the tips. Sparse, discrete high-intensity circular blobs are located in the lower-mid quadrants of both lobes, surrounded by a continuous low-intensity black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 82 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration profile. acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately midway between the median notch and the lateral tip. Small high-intensity clusters (likely barnacles) are visible at the extreme lateral margins of both tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a concentrated field of high-intensity white speckling on the ventral surface of the far right lobe, isolated from the primary leading-edge pigmentation.
